description: This is the main entry point file for a React-based frontend application. It imports React, ReactDOM, global CSS, and the main App component, and renders the App component inside a DOM element with id 'root' within a React.StrictMode wrapper.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root to manage a React component tree within a specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the created root.
